messages.content: I’ll lock in the DA arbitrage position: charge in HE13, discharge in HE20, and recharge in HE24 to meet the ending-SoC requirement. I’ll start with that physical schedule and reassess at each watch as RT prices and notices arrive.

Overnight RT prices have stayed well above DA prices. I’ll move half the discharge to 07:00, then refill at midday. That leaves eight discharge units available for the evening and avoids the planned late-night recharge.

The midday refill is complete. SoC is 16 units, with eight discharge units left under the cycle cap. I’ll retain the 19:00 discharge schedule; it ends at the required eight-unit SoC, and there are no new notices or derates.
